IN PHOTOS │Activists from Salinlahi, GABRIELA, and allied groups held a candle-lighting protest at Boy Scout Circle on Jan. 9, 2026, demanding justice for three Mangyan-Irayan children and two young researchers killed in alleged AFP airstrikes in Abra de Ilog. The groups also called for the safe and immediate return of Chantal Anicoche, denouncing what they described as the military’s escalating attacks on indigenous communities, driven by corporate interests and the U.S.-backed "peace and security" program.

📸: Edd Castro

Narito ang Top 5 Traffic Violations sa katatapos lamang na taong 2025 ayon sa records ng Traffic Ticket Management Division.

Ngayong bagong taon, maging mas disiplinado at patuloy na sumunod sa mga batas trapiko para sa mas maayos na biyahe at mas ligtas na lansangan sa lahat ng mga road user.

Isinusulong ng MMDA ang kaligtasan sa kalsada katuwang ang iba pang ahensiya ng pamahalaan at pribadong sektor alinsunod sa Metro Manila Road Safety Action Plan na target mabawasan ang mga road-related death. Nakatuon ito sa 5 pillars: road safety management, safer roads, safer vehicle, safer road users, at post-crash response.

#mmda
